pages.h1: Can Claude check the current gold price?
pages.title: Can Claude check the gold price today? Live per gram
pages.answer: Not from memory. Claude's training data ends at a cutoff date, and the gold price changes every minute, so any number it recalls is old. With web search on, Claude.ai can find a price quoted on a news or dealer page, but that quote may be delayed and Claude still has to do the karat and gram math itself. Connect the free Gold Price per Gram server and Claude reads the spot price from a live feed at the moment you ask, then works out price per gram by karat, in about 160 currencies.
native: Explains karats, troy ounces and melt value correctly.
Does the arithmetic once it has a price you give it.
With web search on, finds a quoted price on a web page.
needs: The spot price right now, from a live feed, with a timestamp.
Price per gram for 10K to 24K and silver, platinum and palladium.
Melt value of a ring or chain from its weight, with a dealer spread.

example.prompt: I have an 18K gold ring that weighs 6.2 g. What is it worth today, and what would a shop that keeps 15% offer?
example.result: 6.2 gram (g) of 18K gold (75% pure) holds 4.65 g of fine gold, a melt value of 584.47 USD at a spot of 3,909.50 USD per troy ounce (as of 2026-11-03T07:58:26Z). With a 15% dealer spread, a buyer would offer about 496.80 USD. Melt value is not a shop price: retail jewellery sells above melt (making charges, design, brand, tax) and buyers pay below it (refining cost and margin). Ask several buyers for their percentage of melt.

faq.q: Is the gold price from the server real time?
faq.a: It reads the spot price from gold-api.com when the tool runs and returns the timestamp with the answer. Currency conversion uses central-bank rates from Frankfurter.

faq.q: Is melt value what a shop will pay?
faq.a: No. Buyers pay below melt to cover refining and margin, and shops sell jewellery above it. The tool lets you set the dealer spread so you can compare offers.

pages.h1: Can Claude check lake levels?
pages.title: Can Claude check lake levels? Live gauge readings
pages.answer: Not on its own. Claude knows what a full pool is and roughly where big reservoirs sat in past years, but not today's reading. Lake levels move every hour, and the numbers sit in USGS, Army Corps, CDEC, Reclamation and Texas Water Development Board gauges that Claude does not read by default. Connect the free Lake Level server and Claude gets the current elevation from the government gauge, the distance below full pool and the change over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days.
native: Explains full pool, conservation pool and why a lake drops in summer.
Plans a trip around a level you give it.
needs: The current gauge reading for 44 US lakes and reservoirs in 12 states.
Change over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, and feet below full pool.
Up to 365 days of daily or weekly history from the same gauge.

example.prompt: Is Lake Travis up or down this week, and how far below full is it?
example.result: Lake Travis (TX) is at 677.09 ft above sea level per the USGS gauge, measured 2026-11-03T01:45:00-06:00. That is 3.91 ft below full pool (681.0 ft). Change: -0.04 ft in 24 h, -0.05 ft in 7 days, -0.72 ft in 30 days.

faq.q: Which lakes does it cover?
faq.a: 44 US lakes and reservoirs in 12 states, including Lake Travis, Lake Mead, Lake Powell, Lake Lanier, Lake Texoma and Kentucky Lake. Ask it to search by name or state.

faq.q: Where do the numbers come from?
faq.a: USGS, USACE CWMS, CDEC, Reclamation RISE and TWDB gauges, read at call time. Each answer names the gauge and links to its data page.

pages.h1: Can Claude look up the current minimum wage?
pages.title: Can Claude look up the minimum wage for 2026 and 2027?
pages.query: can claude look up minimum wage
pages.answer: Partly. Claude knows the federal $7.25 rate and many state rates up to its training cutoff, but states raise their rates every January, and some mid-year, so the number it remembers can be a year out of date. It also mixes up tipped cash wages. Connect the free Minimum Wage server and Claude reads the state rate in force on any date in 2026 or 2027, with the tipped wage, the tip credit and the next scheduled increase.
native: Knows the federal minimum wage and how tip credits work.
Works out yearly pay once it has an hourly rate.
needs: The rate in force in all 50 states and DC on a date you choose in 2026 or 2027.
Increases already set for 2026 and January 1, 2027.
Tipped cash wage and tip credit for each state.

example.prompt: Compare the minimum wage in Florida, Michigan and Ohio on January 1, 2027.
example.result: On 2027-01-01, Florida has the highest minimum wage of these at $15.00 and Ohio the lowest at $11.40, a gap of $3.60 an hour or $7,488.00 a year full time. State-level rates only. City and county minimum wages (for example Seattle, Denver, Chicago, San Francisco) are out of scope and can be higher.

faq.q: Does it include city minimum wages?
faq.a: No. It returns state rates only. Cities and counties such as Seattle, Denver, Chicago and San Francisco can set higher rates, and the answer says so.

faq.q: How current is the data?
faq.a: US Department of Labor state tables from July 2026, checked against state labor department pages in October 2026, with the source link for each state.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate the no tax on overtime deduction?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate no tax on overtime? Schedule 1-A
pages.query: can claude calculate no tax on overtime
pages.answer: Only if its training includes the July 2025 law, and many Claude versions were trained before it or know it only in outline. The deduction has a $12,500 cap ($25,000 joint), a MAGI phase-out from $150,000 and a rule that only the half-time premium counts, which is easy to get wrong in a long answer. Connect the free No Tax on Overtime server and Claude works out the qualified overtime, the cap and the phase-out the way Schedule 1-A does, for 2025 to 2028.
native: Explains in general terms what the overtime deduction is.
Does simple sums when you give it the qualified amount.
needs: The P.L. 119-21 rules: caps, MAGI phase-outs and the FLSA premium rule.
Tips and senior deductions with the same rules.
The 2025 and 2026 IRS brackets to estimate the tax you save.

example.prompt: I am single, MAGI $68,000. I worked 300 overtime hours in 2025 at $24 an hour, time and a half. What is my overtime deduction?
example.result: Qualified overtime premium $3,600. After the $12,500 cap: $3,600. MAGI $68,000 is not above the $150,000 threshold, so there is no phase-out. Deduction for 2025: $3,600. Only the FLSA premium (the "half" in time-and-a-half) qualifies, not the straight-time part or any extra premium.

faq.q: Does the whole overtime check count?
faq.a: No. Only the premium part counts, the extra half in time and a half. In the example, $10,800 of overtime pay gives a $3,600 deduction.

faq.q: Does it lower Social Security and Medicare tax?
faq.a: No. It lowers federal income tax only. Payroll taxes still apply to overtime pay.

pages.h1: Can Claude adjust a price for inflation?
pages.title: Can Claude adjust for inflation? Official CPI data
pages.answer: It can do the formula, but it does not know the latest CPI. The Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes a new index every month, and Claude only knows the months before its training cutoff, so an inflation-adjusted figure it gives from memory is stale or guessed. Connect the free CPI Inflation Calculator server and Claude uses official BLS CPI-U, CPI-W and core CPI values from 1913 to the latest month, then gives the exact adjusted amount and the yearly rate.
native: Knows the inflation formula: amount times new CPI over old CPI.
Explains the difference between CPI-U, CPI-W and core CPI.
needs: Official monthly and yearly CPI values, 1913 to the latest release.
Whether a raise beat inflation over the same months.
The Social Security COLA for a given year.

example.prompt: What is $50,000 from January 2015 worth now, in buying power?
example.result: $50,000.00 in January 2015 has the same buying power as $72,085.99 in September 2026 (CPI-U 233.707 to 336.94). Cumulative inflation 44.17%, about 3.19% a year over 11.67 years.
example.note: On this run the live BLS check hit its daily request limit, so the server used its bundled BLS data through September 2026 and said so in the answer.

faq.q: Which CPI does it use?
faq.a: CPI-U, all items, US city average, not seasonally adjusted, unless you ask for CPI-W or core CPI.

faq.q: What if the newest month is missing?
faq.a: The answer names the latest month it used. When the live BLS API is not reachable it falls back to bundled data and says so.

pages.h1: Can Claude look up GSA per diem rates?
pages.title: Can Claude look up GSA per diem rates for a trip?
pages.query: can claude look up per diem rates
pages.answer: Not reliably from memory. GSA sets lodging and meals rates for hundreds of US areas each fiscal year, many change by month, and the new year starts every October 1, so the rate Claude remembers is often last year's. Connect the free IRS Mileage Rate and Per Diem server and Claude reads the FY2026 and FY2027 GSA rates by city or ZIP code, then totals a trip with the 75% first and last day rule.
native: Explains what per diem covers and how the 75% travel day rule works.
Adds up a trip once it has the daily rates.
needs: GSA lodging and M&IE rates by city, county or ZIP for FY2026 and FY2027.
Monthly lodging seasons for areas that have them.
The IRS high-low rates and a deduction for meals already provided.

example.prompt: What is the federal per diem for a 4-day trip to Chicago from November 16 to 19, 2026?
example.result: 4-day trip to Chicago, IL (2026-11-16 to 2026-11-19): lodging up to $696.00 for 3 nights, M&IE $322.00 ($92 a full day, $69 first and last day). Maximum per diem $1,018.00.

faq.q: Does it cover trips abroad?
faq.a: No. It covers the continental US (CONUS) GSA rates only.

faq.q: Can my employer pay up to these rates tax free?
faq.a: Under Rev. Proc. 2019-48 an allowance up to the federal rate counts as substantiated, but you still need records of time, place and business purpose.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate a 2026 mileage deduction?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate a 2026 mileage deduction?
pages.answer: It can multiply, but it may use the wrong rate. 2026 has two IRS business rates, 72.5 cents a mile to June 30 and 76 cents from July 1, and the mid-year change came after most models were trained. Medical and charity miles use other rates. Connect the free IRS Mileage Rate and Per Diem server and Claude applies the right rate to each trip by date and purpose, with the IRS notice that sets it.
native: Explains the standard mileage method and what records to keep.
Totals miles from a log you paste.
needs: The IRS rates for business, medical, charity and moving miles, by date.
The July 1, 2026 business rate change (Announcement 2026-11).
A line-by-line deduction with the source for each rate.

example.prompt: Work out my 2026 mileage deduction: 1,240 business miles in March, 85 medical miles in June and 40 charity miles in July.
example.result: 1240 business miles in Jan. 1 - June 30, 2026 at 72.5 cents = $899.00; 85 medical miles in Jan. 1 - June 30, 2026 at 20.5 cents = $17.43; 40 charity miles in July 1 - Dec. 31, 2026 at 14 cents = $5.60. Total $922.03. 2026 has two business rates: 72.5 cents before July 1 and 76 cents from July 1 (Announcement 2026-11).

faq.q: What are the 2026 IRS mileage rates?
faq.a: Business 72.5 cents to June 30, 2026 and 76 cents from July 1. Medical and moving 20.5 cents, then 23.5 cents from July 1. Charity 14 cents, set by law.

faq.q: Are the 2027 rates included?
faq.a: Not yet. The IRS usually announces them in late December, and the server will be updated then.

pages.h1: Can Claude count business days?
pages.title: Can Claude count business days between two dates?
pages.answer: It often gets them wrong. Counting business days means walking a calendar day by day, skipping weekends and the federal holidays, including observed days when a holiday falls on a weekend, and language models are weak at that kind of exact date walk over weeks or months. Connect the free US Federal Holidays and Business Days server and Claude gets an exact count from the OPM rules, 1971 to 2100, plus due dates that roll past weekends and holidays.
native: Lists the federal holidays and explains observed-day rules.
Counts short spans correctly most of the time.
needs: An exact business-day count between any two dates.
Adding N business days, and rolling an invoice due date.
The Federal Reserve banking calendar as a second option.

example.prompt: How many business days are there from December 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027?
example.result: There are 32 business days from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-15 (start included, end included) on the federal calendar: 46 calendar days, 12 weekend days. Excluded weekday holidays: 2026-12-25 Christmas Day; 2027-01-01 New Year's Day.

faq.q: Does it know state holidays?
faq.a: No. It uses the federal and Federal Reserve calendars. You can pass extra closed dates, such as a company shutdown, and they are skipped too.

faq.q: What happens when a holiday falls on a Saturday?
faq.a: Federal offices observe it on the Friday before. The Federal Reserve stays open that Friday, which is why the server has both calendars.

pages.h1: Can Claude look up the 2027 401(k) limits?
pages.title: Can Claude look up 2027 401(k) and IRA limits?
pages.answer: Not yet, and no tool can: on November 3, 2026 the IRS had not announced the 2027 401(k) and IRA limits. Claude may still guess a 2027 number from past increases. Connect the free Retirement Contribution Limits server and Claude gets the published limits only. It says plainly when a year is not out, returns the 2026 figures with the age 60 to 63 super catch-up, and already has the 2027 HSA limits, which are published.
native: Explains catch-up contributions and how 401(k) and IRA limits combine.
Recalls limits for years before its training cutoff.
needs: Published limits only, with a clear answer when a year is not announced.
Your maximum for 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), TSP, SIMPLE, IRA and HSA by age.
The 2027 HSA limits, already set by the IRS.

example.prompt: I am 61. What is the most I can put in my 401(k) and IRA for 2026?
example.result: Age 61 in 2026: 401k $35,750 (incl. $11,250 age 60 63 super catch-up); ira $8,600 (incl. $1,100 age 50 plus catch-up). Combined employee maximum $44,350. Eligible for the age 60-63 super catch-up.

example2.result: The IRS has not announced the 2027 401(k), 403(b), 457, IRA, SIMPLE, 415(c), compensation or HCE limits. On 2026-11-02 the IRS news release list ran through IR-2026-129 (Oct. 29, 2026) with no cost-of-living notice for 2027 (the 2026 notice, IR-2025-111 / Notice 2025-67, came out in November 2025). This server does not guess or forecast. Use 2026 as the latest published year. HSA limits for 2027 are published: use plans ["hsa_self"] or ["hsa_family"] for 2027.

faq.q: When will the 2027 limits come out?
faq.a: The 2026 limits were announced in November 2025 (IR-2025-111, Notice 2025-67). The 2027 notice is expected on a similar schedule. The server adds the figures once the IRS publishes them.

faq.q: What are the 2027 HSA limits?
faq.a: From the server: $4,500 for self-only coverage and $9,000 for family coverage, plus $1,000 at age 55 and over.

pages.h1: Can Claude check the current silver price?
pages.title: Can Claude check the silver price today? Live per gram
pages.answer: Not from memory. Claude's training data stops at a cutoff, and silver trades every minute, so a price it recalls is out of date. With web search on, Claude.ai can find a quote on a web page, but it may be delayed and the fineness and coin math is left to Claude. Connect the free Silver Price per Gram server and Claude reads the spot price live, then gives price per gram for .999, sterling and coin silver, and the melt value of pre-1965 US coins.
native: Explains sterling, coin silver and what junk silver means.
Does the arithmetic once it has a price you give it.
With web search on, finds a quoted price on a web page.
needs: The silver spot price right now, with a timestamp, in about 160 currencies.
Price per gram for .999, .9584, .925, .900 and 800 silver.
Melt value of 90% US coins from face value, and the gold to silver ratio.

example.prompt: I have $5 face value of pre-1965 dimes and quarters. What is the silver worth today, and what would a dealer at 10% under melt pay?
example.result: 5 USD face of 90% coin contain 3.617 troy oz of silver, a melt value of 177.85 USD at a spot of 49.17 USD per troy ounce (as of 2026-11-03T08:01:55Z). One dollar face of pre-1965 90% dimes, quarters or halves holds 0.723392 troy oz (22.5 g), worth 35.57 USD now; dealers often quote 0.715 oz per dollar for worn coins. With a 10% dealer spread, a buyer would offer about 160.06 USD. As-minted silver content; worn coins hold slightly less.

faq.q: Where does the price come from?
faq.a: The gold-api.com silver spot feed, read when the tool runs, with central-bank FX rates from Frankfurter for other currencies.

faq.q: Is melt value what a coin is worth?
faq.a: Not always. Dealers buy below melt and sell above it, and rare or collectible coins can be worth far more than their silver.

pages.h1: Can Claude check river levels?
pages.title: Can Claude check river levels and flood stage?
pages.answer: Not on its own. Claude can explain river stage, discharge and flood categories, but the reading at a gauge changes by the hour and lives in USGS and National Weather Service data that Claude does not read by default. Connect the free River Level server and Claude gets the current stage and flow at any active USGS stream gauge, how far the river is from flood stage, and the NWS forecast where one exists.
native: Explains stage, discharge and the NWS flood categories.
Reads a number you paste from a gauge page.
needs: Current stage and streamflow at any active USGS gauge, found by name, state or location.
Distance to NWS flood stage and forecast crests.
Daily history for 2 to 366 days.

example.prompt: What is the Mississippi River at St. Louis doing right now, and how far is it from flood stage?
example.result: Mississippi River at St. Louis, MO (USGS 07010000): gage height (river stage) 3.59 ft, discharge (streamflow) 126,000 ft3/s, measured 2026-11-03T07:30:00+00:00. NWS flood status: below flood stage, 26.41 ft below flood stage (30 ft).
example.note: The server found the gauge number first with find_river_gauges ("Mississippi River St. Louis", MO), then read it.

faq.q: Is the data official?
faq.a: Yes. It comes from USGS stream gauges and the NOAA National Water Prediction Service. USGS real-time values are provisional and can be revised.

faq.q: Does it cover lakes too?
faq.a: Lakes and reservoirs are in the separate Lake Level server, which reads reservoir elevation and full pool.

pages.h1: Can Claude tell me my SAT percentile?
pages.title: Can Claude tell me my SAT percentile? Class of 2026
pages.query: can claude tell me sat percentile
pages.answer: Roughly, from an older year. Claude has seen College Board percentile tables up to its training cutoff, but the tables are updated each year, and the class of 2026 report came out in fall 2026. From memory it may also mix up the user group and nationally representative percentiles. Connect the free SAT Score Percentiles server and Claude reads both percentiles from the College Board tables, plus the class of 2026 mean and state averages.
native: Explains what a percentile means and how SAT sections combine.
Gives an approximate percentile from older tables.
needs: User group and nationally representative percentiles for total, Math and Reading and Writing.
The class of 2026 mean, score bands and test-taker counts.
Average scores and participation by state.

example.prompt: What percentile is a 1350 on the SAT?
example.result: An SAT total score of 1350 is at the 89th percentile of recent SAT takers (College Board user group percentile) and the 94th percentile of all US 11th and 12th graders (nationally representative percentile). It is 305 points above the class of 2026 mean of 1045 (1,954,833 test takers). 19% of the class of 2026 (377,381 students) scored 1200-1390.

faq.q: What is the difference between the two percentiles?
faq.a: The user group percentile compares you with recent SAT takers. The nationally representative one compares you with all US 11th and 12th graders, including students who do not take the SAT, so it is higher.

faq.q: Is this live data?
faq.a: It is static data from the College Board class of 2026 report. It will be rebuilt when the class of 2027 report comes out.

pages.h1: Can Claude convert cups to grams?
pages.title: Can Claude convert cups to grams? By ingredient
pages.query: can claude convert cups to grams
pages.answer: Partly. A cup measures volume and a gram measures weight, so the answer depends on the ingredient, and Claude gives a typical figure from memory that may not match the chart your recipe was written with. It also has to guess which cup you mean, since US, metric and UK cups differ. Connect the free Cups to Grams server and Claude reads the weight of each ingredient from a named chart, such as King Arthur Baking or USDA FoodData Central, and says which cup it used.
native: Knows that flour, sugar and butter weigh different amounts per cup.
Converts mL, tablespoons and teaspoons, which are fixed volumes.
Scales a recipe up or down once it has the weights.
needs: A gram weight per cup for each ingredient, with the chart it came from.
US, metric and imperial cups kept apart.
Whole recipes scaled to metric weights, and oven temperatures with a fan setting.

example.prompt: How many grams is 1 cup of all-purpose flour?
example.result: 1 us_cup of All-purpose flour = 120 g. Density 120 g per US cup from King Arthur Baking ingredient weight chart (1 cup = 120 g). Cup definition used: US cup (236.5882365 mL). Dry values assume spoon-and-level filling; scooping packs more in.

example2.result: 1 us_cup of Brown sugar (packed) = 220 g. Density 220 g per US cup from USDA FoodData Central FDC 168833 (1 cup packed = 220 g). Cup definition used: US cup (236.5882365 mL). Dry values assume spoon-and-level filling; scooping packs more in.

faq.q: Why is a cup of brown sugar heavier than a cup of flour?
faq.a: Brown sugar is packed into the cup and is denser. In the run above the server gave 220 g for packed brown sugar and 120 g for spooned and leveled flour.

faq.q: Does it handle UK and Australian recipes?
faq.a: Yes. Set the cup system to metric (250 mL) or imperial (284.13 mL), or name the unit, such as metric_cup.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate DSCR for a rental loan?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate DSCR for a rental property loan?
pages.answer: Yes, if you give it every number, but the loan payment math is where long answers slip. DSCR is qualifying rent divided by the full monthly housing cost, and that cost needs an exact amortized payment plus tax, insurance and HOA. Claude also can't know which vacancy factor or ratio band your lender uses. Connect the free DSCR Loan Calculator server and Claude gets the exact payment, PITIA and ratio, the largest loan a target DSCR allows, and the rent you'd need.
native: Explains DSCR, PITIA and why lenders want 1.0 or 1.25.
Gets a close answer when you supply the monthly payment yourself.
needs: The exact principal and interest payment for any rate and term, or interest only.
The maximum loan for a target DSCR and LTV, and the rent needed to hit it.
Side by side scenarios for down payment and rate.

example.prompt: A rental rents for $2,400 a month. I buy it for $300,000 with 25% down at 7.25% for 30 years. Tax is $3,600 a year and insurance $1,500. What is the DSCR with 5% vacancy?
example.result: A $225,000.00 loan at 7.25% over 30 years has a monthly payment of $1,534.90 and PITIA of $1,959.90. Qualifying rent of $2,280.00 gives a DSCR of 1.16 (exact 1.163325), in the 1.00 to 1.24 band. Rent covers PITIA. Many DSCR programs accept 1.00 or more; lenders that want 1.25 will not.

faq.q: Is 1.16 good enough for a DSCR loan?
faq.a: Many programs accept 1.00 or more, and some want 1.25. Minimums and pricing differ by lender, so the server labels the band and doesn't approve anything.

faq.q: Does it use current mortgage rates?
faq.a: No. You give it the rate your lender quoted. It doesn't fetch market rates.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate my take-home pay?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate take-home pay for 2026?
pages.query: can claude calculate take home pay
pages.answer: It gets close, but the small numbers drift. A paycheck needs the 2026 federal brackets, the standard deduction, the Social Security wage base and the state schedule, and several of those changed after most models were trained. Over a long calculation Claude can also round or slip a digit. Connect the free Paycheck Calculator server and Claude runs the exact 2025 or 2026 tables for federal tax, FICA and all 50 states plus DC.
native: Explains brackets, FICA and pre-tax deductions.
Gives a rough estimate from memory.
needs: The 2026 IRS brackets, standard deduction and $184,500 wage base.
Exact 2026 state schedules for CA, NY, NJ, IL, PA, GA and NC, estimates for the rest.
Per-paycheck results for weekly, biweekly, semimonthly and monthly pay.

example.prompt: I got an offer of $92,000 a year, paid biweekly, single, in North Carolina, with 6% to a 401(k). What is my take-home per check in 2026?
example.result: North Carolina, single, 2026: gross $92,000.00 a year ($3,538.46 biweekly). Federal income tax $10,195.60 on taxable income $70,380.00 after the $16,100.00 standard deduction (marginal 22%). Social Security $5,704.00 (6.2% up to the $184,500.00 wage base), Medicare $1,334.00. State income tax $2,941.83 (exact 2026 schedule). Take-home $66,304.57 a year, $2,550.18 per biweekly paycheck; effective tax rate 21.93%.

faq.q: Is this my exact withholding?
faq.a: No. It estimates annual tax on wages with the standard deduction and no credits. Your employer withholds from your W-4, which can differ.

faq.q: Are local taxes included?
faq.a: No. City and county taxes such as NYC, Ohio cities and Pennsylvania EIT, and state payroll taxes such as CA SDI, are left out and the answer says so.

pages.h1: Can Claude work out UK take-home pay for 2026/27?
pages.title: Can Claude work out UK take-home pay for 2026/27?
pages.query: can claude calculate uk take home pay
pages.answer: Roughly. Claude knows how PAYE, National Insurance and student loans work, but the figures move every April, the Scottish bands change on their own schedule, and 2026/27 began after many models were trained. Pension by salary sacrifice also changes the NI and student loan sums in a way that's easy to miss. Connect the free UK Income Tax and Salary server and Claude runs the 2025/26 or 2026/27 rules for your tax code, region, pension and loan plan.
native: Explains tax codes, NI classes and student loan plans.
Gives a ballpark figure from older tax years.
needs: 2025/26 and 2026/27 bands for England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland.
Tax codes including K, BR, D0 and emergency codes.
Salary sacrifice or relief at source pensions, and Plan 1, 2, 4, 5 and postgraduate loans.
Your marginal rate, including the 60% band above £100,000.

example.prompt: I earn £45,000 in England, put 5% into my pension by salary sacrifice and repay a Plan 2 student loan. What is my take-home in 2026/27?
example.result: On £45,000 in 2026/27 (England, Wales or NI, code 1257L) take-home pay is £33,096.75 a year, £2,758.06 a month or £636.48 a week. Income tax £6,036, National Insurance £2,414.40, student loan £1,202.85, pension £2,250 (salary sacrifice).

faq.q: Why can my payslip differ?
faq.a: Payroll works per pay period and the server works on annual figures, so a payslip can differ by a few pounds. The server says so in each answer.

faq.q: Does it cover Scotland?
faq.a: Yes. Set the region to scotland, or use an S tax code, and it applies the six Scottish bands.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate my 2026 ACA premium tax credit?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate the 2026 ACA premium tax credit?
pages.answer: Not safely from memory. The enhanced credits that ran from 2021 to 2025 expired, so for 2026 the 400% of poverty limit is back and the share of income you're expected to pay went up. A model trained before that change can apply the old rules and overstate the credit. Connect the free ACA Premium Tax Credit server and Claude uses the 2025 or 2026 poverty lines and applicable percentages, checks the subsidy cliff and works out the repayment cap.
native: Explains the benchmark silver plan and how the credit is set.
Does the sum once you give it the expected contribution.
needs: The poverty line for your household size and state, including Alaska and Hawaii.
The 2026 applicable figure for your income, and the 400% cliff.
How much excess advance credit you may repay on Form 8962.

example.prompt: We are a household of 2 in Texas with $68,000 income. The benchmark silver plan is $1,150 a month. What is our 2026 premium tax credit?
example.result: 2026 premium tax credit: income $68,000.00 is 321.51% of the $21,150.00 poverty line, applicable figure 9.96%, so the household is expected to pay $6,772.80 a year ($564.40 a month) toward the $13,800.00 benchmark plan. Credit: $7,027.20 a year ($585.60 a month). 2026 rules: enhanced credits expired, 400% FPL limit applies.

faq.q: Where do I find my benchmark premium?
faq.a: HealthCare.gov or your state Marketplace shows the second lowest cost silver plan for your ZIP code and ages. After the year ends it is on Form 1095-A, column B.

faq.q: Is the estimate official?
faq.a: No. The Marketplace and Form 8962 decide the official amounts. The server gives the same math with the published figures.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate calories and nutrition for a recipe?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate calories for a recipe? USDA data
pages.answer: It estimates, and the estimate can be off. Claude has a rough idea of the calories in common foods, but it doesn't look each ingredient up, and adding a dozen remembered values per serving lets small errors stack. Connect the free Recipe Nutrition Calculator server and Claude matches every ingredient line to a USDA FoodData Central food, totals calories, fat, carbs, protein, fiber and sodium, divides by servings and rounds the way an FDA label does.
native: Reads a recipe and lists the ingredients and amounts.
Gives ballpark calories for familiar foods.
needs: A USDA FoodData Central match for each ingredient line, with grams.
Totals and per serving values for calories and the main nutrients.
FDA label rounding, and nutrition for a scaled recipe.

example.prompt: This cake makes 12 slices: 2 cups flour, 1/2 cup butter, 1 cup sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 cup milk, 2 tsp baking powder. How many calories per slice?
example.result: Recipe of 6 lines (916.7 g matched): 2799.5 kcal total, 233.3 kcal per serving over 12 servings. Per serving: 3.9 g protein, 9.4 g fat, 33.8 g carbohydrate, 0.6 g fiber, 162.2 mg sodium. FDA label rounding gives 230 calories per serving. Every line was matched to a USDA FoodData Central food. Values are for the raw ingredients as listed; cooking losses and water evaporation are not modeled.

faq.q: Does it count cooking losses?
faq.a: No. Values are for the raw ingredients as listed. Water lost in baking or fat left in the pan is not modeled, and the answer says so.

faq.q: Can I use it for a food label?
faq.a: It applies FDA rounding rules, but a label you sell under may need lab testing or a dietitian review. Treat it as a well-sourced estimate.

pages.h1: Can Claude look up 2026 AP score distributions?
pages.title: Can Claude look up 2026 AP score distributions?
pages.query: can claude look up ap score distributions
pages.answer: Not the 2026 ones from memory. College Board posts the score distributions each summer after the May exams, and most models were trained before the 2026 release, so Claude may quote an older year without saying so. Connect the free AP Score Distributions server and Claude reads the 2024, 2025 and 2026 figures for each exam, compares exams and estimates a percentile for a score.
native: Explains how AP scores of 1 to 5 work and what colleges accept.
Recalls distributions from years before its training cutoff.
needs: The share of 5s, 4s, 3s, 2s and 1s for each exam in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
A ranking of exams by pass rate or share of 5s.
A percentile estimate for your score, and a score estimate from a practice test.

example.prompt: What were the AP Calculus AB score distributions in 2026?
example.result: AP Calculus AB, May 2026: 20% scored 5, 28% 4, 17% 3, 24% 2, 11% 1; 65% scored 3 or higher. 2026 figures are the whole-number percentages College Board posted on its 2026 AP Score Distributions page; College Board has not published 2026 student counts, means or standard deviations.

faq.q: Are student counts included for 2026?
faq.a: Not yet. College Board posted whole-number percentages for 2026 and has not published the counts, means or standard deviations. The server says so.

faq.q: Which exams does it cover?
faq.a: All AP exams in the College Board release. Ask it to list them, or use short names such as APUSH, Calc BC or APES.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate a Section 179 deduction?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate a 2026 Section 179 deduction?
pages.answer: Not with current limits from memory. The July 2025 tax law (P.L. 119-21) doubled the Section 179 limit and restored 100% bonus depreciation, and the 2026 figures are indexed for inflation, so a model trained earlier quotes the old numbers. Connect the free Section 179 Deduction server and Claude applies the limit and phase-out for the tax year you name, the business income cap, bonus depreciation by date and the vehicle limits.
native: Explains Section 179, bonus depreciation and the business income limit.
Does the math once you give it the right limit.
needs: The Section 179 limit and phase-out threshold for each tax year.
Bonus depreciation by acquisition and in-service date.
Vehicle limits by gross vehicle weight, including the heavy SUV cap.

example.prompt: We are buying $180,000 of equipment in 2026 and the business has $250,000 of taxable income. How much can we deduct under Section 179?
example.result: 2026 Section 179 limit $2,560,000. Property cost $180,000 is under the $4,090,000 threshold, so the full limit applies. Elected $180,000. Deduction this year $180,000.

faq.q: What is the 2026 Section 179 limit?
faq.a: From the server: $2,560,000, reduced dollar for dollar once qualifying property tops $4,090,000.

faq.q: Can the deduction create a loss?
faq.a: No. Section 179 is capped at business taxable income. Bonus depreciation has no such cap, which is why the server handles both.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate the car loan interest deduction?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate the new car loan interest deduction?
pages.query: can claude calculate car loan interest deduction
pages.answer: Only if it knows the 2025 law, and many Claude versions don't, or know it only in outline. The deduction runs from 2025 to 2028, is capped at $10,000 a year, phases out above $100,000 of MAGI ($200,000 joint) and only covers new vehicles with US final assembly bought on a loan made after 2024. Connect the free Car Loan Interest Deduction server and Claude checks each rule and works out the deduction and the phase-out.
native: Explains in general terms that some car loan interest became deductible.
Adds numbers you give it.
needs: The P.L. 119-21 rules: the cap, the MAGI phase-out and the vehicle tests.
A clear no when a used car, a lease or a business vehicle fails a test.
The 2025 and 2026 brackets, SALT cap and child tax credit for the rest of the return.

example.prompt: I am single with $85,000 MAGI. I bought a new US-assembled car on a loan made in March 2025 and paid $2,400 interest in 2025. What can I deduct?
example.result: Interest counted $2,400, $2,400 after the $10,000 cap. MAGI $85,000 is not over the $100,000 threshold, so nothing is phased out. Car loan interest deduction for 2025: $2,400. Assumed: the gross vehicle weight rating is under 14,000 pounds; the loan is secured by a first lien on the vehicle; the vehicle is a car, minivan, van, SUV, pickup truck or motorcycle.

faq.q: Do I have to itemize?
faq.a: No. It is a deduction you can take with the standard deduction, on Schedule 1-A.

faq.q: How do I check final assembly?
faq.a: The vehicle label on the window shows it, or the NHTSA VIN decoder. The server asks for it as a yes or no.

pages.h1: Can Claude find the subdomains of a website?
pages.title: Can Claude find subdomains of a domain? From CT logs
pages.answer: Not on its own. Claude can't send DNS queries or read certificate transparency logs, and web search only shows hosts that someone happened to link to. Connect the free Subdomain Finder server and Claude reads public certificate transparency logs (Cert Spotter, then crt.sh) for the domain, lists the hostnames with first and last seen dates, flags wildcard certificates and can resolve the names over DNS. Use it on domains you own or are allowed to test.
native: Explains certificate transparency, DNS and what a subdomain is.
Suggests common names such as www, mail and api to check by hand.
needs: Every hostname that appeared on a public TLS certificate for the domain.
Wildcard entries, which hide individual hosts.
DNS resolution and a short attack surface summary.

example.prompt: Which subdomains of zovo.one show up in certificate logs?
example.result: 101 unique hostnames under zovo.one in 218 certificates from certspotter (first 3 pages only; raise max_pages for more). 100 wildcard entries (*.anon.zovo.one, *.ar-aging.zovo.one, *.avery-labels.zovo.one, ...), so some hosts will never appear in CT. Newest: ar-aging.zovo.one (2026-10-26), cap-table.zovo.one (2026-10-26), client-report.zovo.one (2026-10-26), depreciation.zovo.one (2026-10-26), gradebook.zovo.one (2026-10-26). Showing 20 of 101. certspotter lists unexpired certificates only.
example.note: zovo.one is our own domain. The full answer lists each hostname with its dates and certificate issuer.

faq.q: Does it scan or brute force anything?
faq.a: No. It reads public certificate transparency logs and, if you ask, resolves names over DNS. It does not probe ports or guess names.

faq.q: Why are some hosts missing?
faq.a: A host behind a wildcard certificate never appears by name in the logs, and certspotter lists unexpired certificates only. Use crt.sh with expired certificates for older names.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate A/B test sample size?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate A/B test sample size and duration?
pages.query: can claude calculate ab test sample size
pages.answer: It knows the formula, but the exact number is easy to get wrong. Sample size depends on z-scores, pooled or unpooled variance and one or two sided tests, and online calculators don't agree on those choices, so a figure from memory can be off by thousands of users. Connect the free A/B Test Sample Size Calculator server and Claude gets the exact count per arm, says which method it used, and turns traffic into days to run the test.
native: Explains power, significance and minimum detectable effect.
Gives a rough sample size for a common case.
needs: The exact sample size per arm for any baseline, lift, alpha, power and number of arms.
Test duration from daily traffic, rounded to full weeks.
Significance tests, Fisher exact test and the cost of peeking.

example.prompt: My checkout converts at 4%. How many users do I need to detect a 10% relative lift?
example.result: To detect a change from 4.00% to 4.40% (10.0% relative MDE) with 80% power at alpha 0.05 two-sided, you need 39,475 users in control and in each variant: 78,950 in total across 2 arms. Evan Miller's calculator gives 38,210 per arm for the same inputs (it uses the baseline variance in both terms and always two-sided alpha).

example2.prompt: We get 3,000 visitors a day into the test. How long will it take?
example2.result: 39,475 users per arm x 2 arms = 78,950 users. At 3,000 test visitors a day that takes 27 days; run 4 full weeks (28 days) so every weekday is covered equally.

faq.q: Why does Evan Miller's calculator give a different number?
faq.a: It uses the baseline variance in both terms. The server uses pooled variance under the null and unpooled under the alternative, and quotes both numbers so you can compare.

faq.q: Can I stop the test early if it looks significant?
faq.a: Checking results again and again raises the false positive rate. The check_peeking_risk tool shows by how much.

pages.h1: Can Claude calculate a RAP student loan payment?
pages.title: Can Claude calculate a RAP student loan payment?
pages.query: can claude calculate rap student loan payment
pages.answer: Not reliably. The Repayment Assistance Plan comes from the July 2025 law and opened on July 1, 2026, which is after many models were trained, so Claude may not know its income tiers, the $50 a month credit per dependent or the new Tiered Standard plan. Connect the free Student Loan RAP Calculator server and Claude works out the RAP payment, compares it with the standard plans and shows the loan limits and plan dates that apply to you.
native: Explains income-driven repayment in general terms.
Compares plans once it has the monthly payments.
needs: The RAP payment from AGI and dependents, with the $10 minimum.
RAP against the Tiered Standard and 10-year Standard plans, monthly and in total.
Which plans close and when, and the new federal loan limits.

example.prompt: I owe $38,000 at 6.5%, my AGI is $52,000 and I have 1 dependent. What would I pay under RAP and under the standard plans?
example.result: For $38,000.00 at 6.5% and AGI $52,000.00: RAP $166.67 a month, $19,869.14 cancelled after 360 payments, total $60,001.20. Tiered Standard (15 years) $331.02 a month, total $59,583.79. 10-year Standard $431.48 a month, total $51,778.01. Lowest monthly payment: RAP. Lowest total paid: 10-year Standard. RAP and the 10-year Standard plan count toward PSLF; Tiered Standard does not.

faq.q: Is this my official payment?
faq.a: No. Your servicer sets it from your certified income and loan records. Check it with the StudentAid.gov Loan Simulator.

faq.q: Does RAP count for PSLF?
faq.a: Yes. On-time RAP payments count toward Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and so do payments under the 10-year Standard plan. Tiered Standard payments do not (20 U.S.C. 1087e(m)(1)(A), as amended by P.L. 119-21 sec. 82004).

pages.h1: Can Claude tell the time in another time zone?
pages.title: Can Claude tell the time in another time zone?
pages.answer: Not by itself. Claude has no clock, so it doesn't know the current time unless the app passes it in, and some apps only pass the date. Time zone math also trips on daylight saving: the US and Europe change clocks on different dates, so for a few weeks a year the gap between New York and London is 4 hours, not 5. Connect the Timezone server (free token) and Claude reads the current time from the server and converts times with the IANA rules for the exact date.
native: Knows the usual UTC offsets for major cities.
Explains daylight saving time and what EST and EDT mean.
needs: The current time in any city, from a real clock.
Conversions that apply daylight saving for the exact date.
Working hour overlap across cities, meeting slots and .ics invites.

example.prompt: What time is it right now in Tokyo, London and New York?
example.result: Now (2026-11-03T08:23:29.200Z UTC); Tokyo -> Asia/Tokyo: 2026-11-03 17:23 Tue (GMT+9, UTC+09:00); London -> Europe/London: 2026-11-03 08:23 Tue (GMT, UTC+00:00); New York -> America/New_York: 2026-11-03 03:23 Tue (EST, UTC-05:00)

example2.prompt: A call is set for 9:00 New York time on March 17, 2027. What time is that in London and Berlin?
example2.result: New York -> America/New_York: 2027-03-17 09:00 Wed (EDT, UTC-04:00); London -> Europe/London: 2027-03-17 13:00 Wed (GMT, UTC+00:00); Berlin -> Europe/Berlin: 2027-03-17 14:00 Wed (GMT+1, UTC+01:00); UTC instant: 2027-03-17T13:00:00.000Z
example2.note: On March 17, 2027 New York is already on daylight time and London is not, so the gap is 4 hours.

faq.q: Does Claude know today's date?
faq.a: Many apps give Claude the date in the system prompt, but not always the exact time, and Claude can't check either one. The server reads the time when the tool runs.

faq.q: What is free on the hosted server?
faq.a: Time conversion, overlap, daylight saving dates and business days are free. Meeting slots for more than 3 people, longer searches, more saved contacts and more .ics files are Pro.

pages.h1: Can Claude convert currency at today's exchange rate?
pages.title: Can Claude convert currency at today's rate? ECB rates
pages.answer: Not from memory. Exchange rates change every day and Claude only knows rates from before its training cutoff, so any conversion it does alone uses an old rate. With web search on, Claude.ai can find a quote on a web page, but it may not say which date or source the rate is from. Connect the Currency server (free token) and Claude converts with the European Central Bank reference rate, names the rate date and rounds to the currency's minor units.
native: Does the multiplication once it has a rate you trust.
Explains reference rates, cross rates and why banks charge a spread.
needs: The latest ECB reference rate for every currency the ECB quotes.
The rate date, so an invoice or expense report can cite it.
One amount in several currencies, and the rate on a past date within the last 90 days on the free tier.

example.prompt: Convert 250 euros to US dollars at today's rate.
example.result: {"result": "USD 280.40", "rate_meaning": "1 EUR = 1.1216 USD", "rate_date": "2026-11-02", "source": "European Central Bank"}
example.note: The server answers in JSON. These are four of its fields, unchanged. The ECB publishes once per business day, around 16:00 CET, so the rate date can be the day before.

faq.q: Is the ECB rate what my bank will charge?
faq.a: No. The ECB reference rate is a mid-market rate for information. Banks and card networks add a spread or a fee.

faq.q: How far back does it go?
faq.a: The free tier reads rates for the last 90 days. History back to January 1999 is in Pro.
